scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The Google account email that becomes the admin, who creates boards, sets statuses, merges and deletes.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: From a Google OAuth client (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials). Leave empty to disable Google sign-in.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The secret that goes with the Google OAuth client id above.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A random string of 32 characters or more, used to sign sign-in sessions. Changing it signs everyone out.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: From Cloudflare Turnstile (add a widget), used to keep bots from posting, voting and commenting.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: The secret that goes with the Turnstile site key above.

DB.description: Where boards, ideas, votes and comments are kept.

BACKUPS.description: Where the nightly backup of your boards is kept. Keep this bucket private.
